statements.impact_statement: The one-time RabbitMQ 3.13 source runs with network_mode none, no plugins or secrets, and cannot expose a Megaco listener.
The one-time RabbitMQ 3.13 source has no network namespace connectivity and cannot establish or accept an SCTP association.
The one-time RabbitMQ 3.13 source has no network connectivity or TLS listener and receives no application traffic.
The one-time container has an isolated network namespace, so an external actor cannot reach epmd or consume its file descriptors.
The one-time RabbitMQ 3.13 source has no network connectivity, TLS listener, client role, plugins, or application traffic.
The one-time RabbitMQ 3.13 source has no network connectivity and performs no inbound or outbound TLS certificate validation.
The source starts only after queues are proven drained, has no application traffic or plugins, and has no peer capable of supplying attacker-controlled Erlang external terms.
The one-time RabbitMQ 3.13 source has no network connectivity and makes no TLS client connections.
